exposure: pelvic organ prolapse (POP) surgery with and without concomitant midurethral sling
cohort: The study involved 203 women undergoing pelvic organ prolapse surgery, with and without concomitant midurethral sling, between 2011 and 2016.
finding: Approximately 61% of patients undergoing POP surgery experienced resolution of OAB symptoms postoperatively, while older age was significantly related to persistent OAB symptoms, and 6% developed de novo OAB symptoms.
